items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was with Art Blakey, he was with the Jazz Messengers

ctx.x: I know the name very well, but I don‘t know too much about Woody Shaw. He was a good trumpet player too, I heard. I knew him, I never heard him play, Woody Shaw. Who did he play with?
Well, he was with Art Blakey, he was with the Jazz Messengers and then…
